name: Netbox
tagline: An IP address management (IPAM) and data center infrastructure management (DCIM) tool. Initially conceived by the network engineering team at DigitalOcean, NetBox was developed specifically to address the needs of network and infrastructure engineers. It is intended to function as a domain-specific source of truth for network operations.
description: Netbox is an IP address management (IPAM) and data center infrastructure management (DCIM) tool. Initially conceived by the network engineering team at DigitalOcean, NetBox was developed specifically to address the needs of network and infrastructure engineers. It is intended to function as a domain-specific source of truth for network operations.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  app:
    image: linuxserver/netbox:4.7.3@sha256:f894fe3820a1d69c32cb147f5dc4bcdd0205e6394db9fd6abbccca5890f49b7f
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      PUID: $PUID
      PGID: $PGID
      TZ: $TZ
      SUPERUSER_EMAIL: $SUPERUSER_EMAIL
      SUPERUSER_PASSWORD: $SUPERUSER_PASSWORD
      ALLOWED_HOST: $ALLOWED_HOST
      DB_NAME: $DB_NAME
      DB_USER: $DB_USER
      DB_PASSWORD: $DB_PASSWORD
      DB_HOST: $DB_HOST
      DB_PORT: $DB_PORT
      REDIS_HOST: $REDIS_HOST
      REDIS_PORT: $REDIS_PORT
      REDIS_USERNAME: $REDIS_USERNAME
      REDIS_PASSWORD: $REDIS_PASSWORD
      REDIS_DB_TASK: $REDIS_DB_TASK
      REDIS_DB_CACHE: $REDIS_DB_CACHE
      BASE_PATH: $BASE_PATH
      CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS: $CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS
      REMOTE_AUTH_ENABLED: $REMOTE_AUTH_ENABLED
      REMOTE_AUTH_BACKEND: $REMOTE_AUTH_BACKEND
      REMOTE_AUTH_HEADER: $REMOTE_AUTH_HEADER
      REMOTE_AUTH_AUTO_CREATE_USER: $REMOTE_AUTH_AUTO_CREATE_USER
      REMOTE_AUTH_DEFAULT_GROUPS: $REMOTE_AUTH_DEFAULT_GROUPS
      REMOTE_AUTH_DEFAULT_PERMISSIONS: $REMOTE_AUTH_DEFAULT_PERMISSIONS
    ports:
      - target: 8000
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config
        target: /config
notes: Configure the required administrator, database, and Redis settings before installing. This app requires external services and will not start with empty defaults.
